product.title: Miami Jet Ski Rental
product.description: Experience Miami from the water with a guided jet ski rental session designed for first-time and experienced riders. After a brief safety orientation, guests head into Biscayne Bay to ride with skyline views and open-water stretches.
highlights: Guided jet ski experience in Biscayne Bay
Safety briefing and operating instructions included
Views of the Miami skyline from the water
Great option for first-time and returning riders

itineraryItems.title: Safety check-in and briefing
itineraryItems.description: Meet staff, complete check-in, and review safety/ride instructions.

itineraryItems.title: Guided jet ski ride
itineraryItems.description: Ride through designated zones with views of Miami and Biscayne Bay.

additionalInfo: Arrive 20 to 30 minutes before your scheduled departure
Weather and water conditions can affect departure timing

faqs.question: How long is the jet ski rental experience?
faqs.answer: The on-water guided session is about 45 minutes with additional time for check-in and the safety briefing.

faqs.question: Where is the meeting point?
faqs.answer: The listed meeting point is Miami Beach Marina at 300 Alton Rd, Miami Beach, Florida.

faqs.question: Is prior jet ski experience required?
faqs.answer: No. The experience includes a pre-ride orientation and safety instructions.
